response.justification: The candidate lacks the required 8 years of C++ experience and 5 years of large-scale cloud infrastructure or distributed systems design, with most roles centered on TypeScript, Node.js, and web technologies; while they have broad full-stack experience and strong open-source contributions, there is minimal evidence of cloud compute platform leadership or C++-centric systems work at the scale required.
strengths: Strong open-source contributions and technical mentoring through workshops and tools
Broad full-stack experience across languages and domains including DevOps and CI/CD
Proven ability to lead ambiguous projects and deliver user-facing systems
concerns: Only 1-2 years of C++ experience (LabWindows/CVI), far below the 8-year minimum
No demonstrable experience with cloud compute platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure infrastructure at scale)
Lacks evidence of technical leadership in distributed systems or infrastructure teams
